{"status": "proposed","mechanism": "W1路线保持+数牌限定放宽（W1-Hold/Suit-Release）：以‘暗手恰含1张白板、普通与七对向听均≤2、墙余≥12’为路线入口；路线内仅当候选弃牌为数牌（非字牌、非白板）、standard_shanten_after与父代持平、standard_useful_tiles严格增加、seven_pairs_shanten_after不劣化、baotou_after不下降全部成立时，才改选父代排序中最高分的该类候选；字牌弃牌换宽（G233两根H负例的行动前可见模式：弃北/弃中换更宽进张）与任何白板弃牌一律保持父代。意图：在H负例模式零触达以保护平胡·财飘·爆头与七对·爆头等已有高番，在M正例模式（弃2b类数牌换宽）第一次出现即可触达，绕开‘仅在第二次反转才改弃’的17/128触达上限；不改river_part/style_part、不加固定宽度奖金、不做两摸/三摸结算搜索、不回填未来结算。","entry": "仅本人正常摸打窗（full_hand恰14张）；候选facts中无可见可胡标志；手牌token全部可读且白板数恰为1；父代候选standard_shanten_after≤2且seven_pairs_shanten_after≤2；墙余可数值化且≥12；任一事实未知、不可解析或属性缺失→不进入（弃权回父代）。入口纯由当窗可见量重算，不依赖历史反转记忆，因此既不做第一次无差别改宽，也不以‘第二次重复反转’为触发条件。","hold": "路线内每窗重算：候选弃牌token不可解析、为白板或为字牌者一律跳过；其余候选须同向听(sc==sp)、standard_useful_tiles严格增(uc>up)、七对向听不升(qc≤q7)、baotou_after不降(nbc≥nbp)；合格者取total_score最高（平分取计划序更前者）；无合格者保持父代。普通胡保护=向听永不上升且进张严格增加；高番保护=七对与爆头分支事实逐候选不劣化；白板永不因本控制器被弃。","exit": "出现任一条件即停用路线并回父代，待下窗按可见量重新判定：白板数≠1；standard_shanten_after>2或seven_pairs_shanten_after>2；墙余<12（后期不做结构改造，交还父代熟牌/风险逻辑）；full_hand≠14（非正常摸打窗，含副露后窗口）；存在可见可胡候选；任一必需fact缺失。重启/序号缺口/无历史：confirmed_memory为空或版本不符时决策与有内存时逐位相同（决策不读内存），天然回退父代。","selector_code": "def select(request, plan, confirmed_memory):\n    # W1 route hold + suit-only widening release.\n    # Returns (action_key | None, audit, memory); None => keep parent's action.\n    # UNKNOWN-HANDLING RULE: any missing/None fact propagates to abstain;\n    # unknowns are NEVER zero-filled, NEVER guessed. No clock/file/net/search.\n    audit = {'route': 'W1', 'decision': 'abstain', 'stage': 'init'}\n    mem = {'route_version': 1}\n    if confirmed_memory.get('route_version') not in (None, 1):\n        audit['stage'] = 'memory_version_mismatch'\n        return (None, audit, mem)\n    cands = list(getattr(plan, 'candidates', None) or [])\n    if not cands:\n        audit['stage'] = 'empty_plan'\n        return (None, audit, mem)\n    # CandidateFacts live on request.rules.legal_candidates, keyed by action_key;\n    # fall back to mirrored attrs on the plan candidate if a build provides them.\n    fmap = {}\n    lcs = getattr(getattr(request, 'rules', None), 'legal_candidates', None) or []\n    for lf in lcs:\n        k = getattr(lf, 'action_key', None)\n        if k is not None:\n            fmap[str(k)] = lf\n\n    def fact(c, name):\n        lf = fmap.get(str(getattr(c, 'action_key', '')), None)\n        v = getattr(lf, name, None) if lf is not None else None\n        if v is None:\n            v = getattr(c, name, None)\n        return v\n\n    def num(x):\n        if x is None:\n            return None\n        if isinstance(x, bool):\n            return 1.0 if x else 0.0\n        if isinstance(x, (int, float)):\n            return float(x)\n        if isinstance(x, (list, tuple, set, str)):\n            return float(len(x))\n        return None  # unknown shape -> unknown\n\n    # parent pick: explicit marker first, else first max total_score (plan order)\n    parent = None\n    for c in cands:\n        if getattr(c, 'is_chosen', None) is True or getattr(c, 'chosen', None) is True:\n            parent = c\n            break\n    if parent is None:\n        for c in cands:\n            if num(getattr(c, 'total_score', None)) is None:\n                audit['stage'] = 'unknown_total_score'\n                return (None, audit, mem)\n        parent = max(cands, key=lambda c: num(getattr(c, 'total_score', None)))\n    audit['parent_key'] = str(getattr(parent, 'action_key', ''))\n    try:\n        full_hand = _build_context(request.observation).full_hand()  # production\n    except Exception:\n        audit['stage'] = 'hand_unavailable'\n        return (None, audit, mem)\n    if not full_hand or len(full_hand) != 14:\n        audit['stage'] = 'not_normal_draw_window'\n        return (None, audit, mem)\n    WHITE = ('白', 'bai', 'white', 'wd')\n\n    def tile_str(t):\n        s = t if isinstance(t, str) else getattr(t, 'name', None) or getattr(t, 'key', None)\n        if s is None:\n            s = str(t)\n        return s if isinstance(s, str) and s else None\n\n    n_white = 0\n    for t in full_hand:\n        s = tile_str(t)\n        if s is None:\n            audit['stage'] = 'hand_tile_token_unknown'\n            return (None, audit, mem)\n        if s in WHITE:\n            n_white += 1\n    HONOR = ('东', '南', '西', '北', '中', '发', '白', 'E', 'S', 'W', 'N', 'C', 'F', 'B', 'wd', 'gd')\n\n    def discard_tok(c):\n        # Discard-tile identity: MUST be validated offline against the real\n        # action_key format; any doubt returns None and the candidate is never\n        # selected (abstain-side default).\n        for a in ('tile', 'discard_tile', 'tile_key'):\n            v = getattr(c, a, None)\n            if isinstance(v, str) and v:\n                return v\n        ak = getattr(c, 'action_key', None)\n        if not isinstance(ak, str) or '_' not in ak:\n            return None\n        tail = ak.split('_')[-1]\n        return tail if 1 <= len(tail) <= 3 else None\n\n    # a visible win candidate aborts the route (protect ordinary wins)\n    for c in cands:\n        for w in ('can_win', 'is_win', 'can_agari', 'agari', 'is_hu'):\n            if fact(c, w) is True:\n                audit['stage'] = 'win_candidate_visible'\n                return (None, audit, mem)\n    sp = num(fact(parent, 'standard_shanten_after'))\n    q7 = num(fact(parent, 'seven_pairs_shanten_after'))\n    wall = None\n    for a in ('wall_remainder', 'wall_remaining', 'wall_left', 'tiles_remaining', 'wall_count'):\n        v = num(getattr(request.observation, a, None))\n        if v is not None:\n            wall = v\n            break\n    if sp is None or q7 is None or wall is None:\n        audit['stage'] = 'entry_fact_unknown'\n        return (None, audit, mem)\n    audit.update({'n_white': n_white, 'sp': sp, 'q7': q7, 'wall': wall})\n    if not (n_white == 1 and sp <= 2.0 and q7 <= 2.0 and wall >= 12.0):\n        audit['decision'] = 'parent'\n        audit['stage'] = 'out_of_route'\n        return (None, audit, mem)\n    up = num(fact(parent, 'standard_useful_tiles'))\n    bp = fact(parent, 'baotou_after')\n    if up is None or bp is None:\n        audit['decision'] = 'hold_parent'\n        audit['stage'] = 'parent_facts_unknown'\n        return (None, audit, mem)\n    nbp = num(bp)\n    best = None\n    for c in cands:\n        if c is parent:\n            continue\n        tok = discard_tok(c)\n        if tok is None or tok in WHITE or tok in HONOR:\n            continue  # unknown / white / honor discard -> never released\n        sc = num(fact(c, 'standard_shanten_after'))\n        uc = num(fact(c, 'standard_useful_tiles'))\n        qc = num(fact(c, 'seven_pairs_shanten_after'))\n        bc = fact(c, 'baotou_after')\n        nbc = num(bc) if bc is not None else None\n        if sc is None or uc is None or qc is None or nbc is None:\n            continue  # unknown fact -> candidate unusable\n        if sc != sp or not (uc > up) or qc > q7 or nbc < nbp:\n            continue  # equal shanten + strictly wider + chiitoi/baotou guards\n        sco = num(getattr(c, 'total_score', None))\n        if sco is None:\n            continue\n        if best is None or sco > best[0]:\n            best = (sco, str(getattr(c, 'action_key', '')))\n    if best is None:\n        audit['decision'] = 'hold_parent'\n        audit['stage'] = 'no_qualified_release'\n        return (None, audit, mem)\n    audit['decision'] = 'release'\n    audit['stage'] = 'suit_widen_release'\n    audit['release_key'] = best[1]\n    audit['release_score'] = best[0]\n    mem['last_release'] = best[1]\n    return (best[1], audit, mem)","state_and_recovery": "状态={(game_id,round_no,seat)→{route_version,last_release}}，由包装器仅在本人动作被权威确认后写入，重复窗口以首次确认为准。路线成员资格是当窗纯函数（full_hand白板数+父代候选双shanten+墙余），完全无内存即可恢复；内存仅作版本校验与审计，不参与任何决策，因此序号缺口/重启/无历史与正常路径走同一代码、同一决策，回退即父代。","observable_fields": "request.observation：本人暗手（生产_build_context(observation).full_hand()）、墙余（wall_remainder或同义属性名，取第一个可数值化者，全不可读→弃权）、白板标记；request.rules.legal_candidates：standard_shanten_after、seven_pairs_shanten_after、standard_useful_tiles、baotou_after、可胡标志（can_win/is_win等，经action_key对齐，缺→未知→弃权）；plan.candidates：action_key、total_score、is_chosen类标记（如有）。本次不读取score_trace.detail（base_score/river_part/style_part/risk_units一律不用）、他家暗手、他家手牌张数、公开弃牌、WorldState、未来牌山、积分、时钟/文件/网络；未知事实以None传播并弃权，绝不补零。","negative_controls": "（1）恒等桩：select恒返回None，须与父代在全部同牌山四座换位八局完整桌逐动作比特恒等，任何偏差判接线失败并拒绝；（2）反向释放对照：把数牌条件取反为字牌-only释放、其余门不变，预注册预期为非正（应趋近G193的-0.463量级），若显著为正则门逻辑混淆、候选作废；（3）去白门对照：删去n_white==1、其余不变，预期回落到G193区间，证明‘恰一白’入口承载效应而非宽度本身有效；（4）H回归件：G233 H根3/H根6的进入窗（事后已知结局，仅作离线固定夹具，绝不做线上输入，不硬编码牌谱ID到线上路径）上控制器必须选父代1t（弃权），逐动作断言；（5）保护断言：所有触达窗逐窗验证qc≤q7且nbc≥nbp且sc==sp且uc>up，普通胡/七对/爆头分支无退化。","behavior_dedup": "对评估集每个正常摸打窗记录六元组(parent_key,ours_key,g168_key,g171_key,g193_key,g221_key)，Touched(X)={w:X(w)≠parent(w)}。预注册断言：a) ours触达窗中与G193同改比例≤0.6，且逐窗同键率>95%判为重复失败；b) 在路线入口集内、更宽改弃需弃字牌的窗口（含两H回归件），ours==parent而G193==备选，即ours与G193在此类窗口强制分离；c) ours不读取任何结算分或两摸互斥分（audit无score_trace字段），与G221机制可分离：报告触达窗中G221与ours选择不同的比例；d) 与G168/G171按同法报告Jaccard，>0.95判重；e) 与P22区分：本控制器无rollout、无重采样、无随机臂，逐窗决策为可见量的确定性函数，可重放复核。","runtime_bound": "每窗：1次full_hand构建（生产已有）+O(C)候选扫描（C≤约40），每候选常数次getattr、字典查找与一次尾缀切分；无嵌套搜索、无随机、无I/O、无递归；典型<2ms，含审计字典<10ms，40候选最坏<50ms，全部在3秒正常摸打窗内；非正常摸打窗（1秒窗）因full_hand≠14或事实缺失恒弃权，零额外成本。","falsifier": "全新H/M异质对手池、同牌山四座换位八局完整桌、等权评估，预注册判负条件（任一命中即拒绝归档）：任一池均分<+2分/桌或两池不同正；根级（桌×座根）95%CI下界≤0；恒等桩与父代不比特恒等；任一H回归件未弃权；触达窗中任一保护断言被打破；任一窗>50ms；触达率<10%（此时需每触达桌>20分，超出G233量级的可解释范围）；与G193逐窗同键率>95%。在通过全部验收前不得声称任何收益。","uncertainty": "收益未证明：G235/G233均非收益标签。字牌vs数牌弃牌区分（弃北/弃中→H负、弃2b→M正）是对仅3根同牌山重放的事后可见假设，样本极小，‘恰一白+双向听≤2+墙余≥12’的入口本身来自这3例，存在选择偏差；同牌山单世界结算方差大，首次两摸/三摸高番值无法区分正负是已知事实，本设计对这些情形一律弃权而非预测。baotou_after的语义与单调性、standard_useful_tiles是计数还是集合、action_key尾缀token格式、父代选择标记（is_chosen或max total_score先到先得）均需在真实对象上离线验证；任一解析失败路径=恒弃权=零触达（安全侧但无增益）。墙余≥12与各阈值为预注册常数，未经扫描调优也不得调优后再报。本候选仅申请进入上述验收流程。"}
